coverage.summary: Applies statewide to owners of residential rental property, and their agents, who charge application screening fees to applicants for a residential housing unit, including guarantors and cosigners. There are no unit-count, construction-date or owner-size limits.
coverage.other_conditions: Not intended to preempt provisions or regulations governing deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs (subd. (l)).

evidence.quoted_span: As used in this section, “landlord” means an owner of residential rental property.

As used in this section, “applicant” means any entity or individual who makes a request to a landlord or their agent to rent a residential housing unit, or an entity or individual who agrees to act as a guarantor or cosignor on a rental agreement.
As used in this section, “landlord” means an owner of residential rental property.
to preempt any provisions or regulations that govern the collection of deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs.

result.notes: I removed the summary's reference to Berkeley BMC ch. 13.78 for three reasons: it is a local overlay, not coverage of this state rule; D005 is not among the supplied documents; and no supplied document contains a verbatim passage supporting it. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the section covers all owners of residential rental property, not a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify. The statute in D026 contains no unit-count, construction-date, owner-size or owner-occupancy limits.
